title: Range Input With Output
code:
<label for="vol">Volume</label>
<input type="range" id="vol" min="0" max="100" value="50"
  oninput="volDisplay.value = this.value">
<output id="volDisplay">50</output>

title: Form Association With form Attribute
code:
<form id="settings-form" action="/settings">
  <label for="theme">Theme</label>
  <select id="theme" name="theme" form="settings-form">
    <option value="dark">Dark</option>
    <option value="light">Light</option>
  </select>
</form>

<!-- Button outside form, still submits it: -->
<button type="submit" form="settings-form">Save</button>

title: requestSubmit vs submit
formenctype for File Uploads
code:
<form method="POST" enctype="application/x-www-form-urlencoded">
  <input type="file" name="avatar">
  <button type="submit">Upload</button>
</form>

bugs.explanation: The default `enctype="application/x-www-form-urlencoded"` encodes form data as key-value pairs — it cannot transmit binary file data. For file uploads, `enctype="multipart/form-data"` must be used so the browser sends files as binary content.
